title: 面向大规模动态图的图神经网络优化机制研究

novelty_points.claim: 提出了一种新的图表示学习模型——GSAERU，用于大规模时序图数据上的节点表征学习。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposed a new graph representation learning model, GSAERU, for node representation learning on large-scale sequential graphs.
technical_features: 引入图摘要技术将原图映射到固定规模的新图中
解决了GNN模型输出无法直接输入到RNN模型中进行训练的问题
technical_features_en: Introduced graph summarization technology to map the original graph to a fixed-size new graph
Solved the problem where the output of GNN cannot be directly input into RNN for training

novelty_points.claim: 利用图摘要技术加速模型训练和减少模型占用的计算资源。
novelty_points.claim_en: Utilized graph summarization technology to accelerate model training and reduce computational resource usage.
technical_features: 从大规模图生成多个规模较小的子图
在这些子图上进行训练，降低训练成本
technical_features_en: Generated multiple smaller subgraphs from the large-scale graph
Performed training on these subgraphs to reduce training costs

novelty_points.claim: 提出了一种新的基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络训练框架，称为DSGNN。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposed a new distributed graph neural network training framework based on graph summarization, called DSGNN.
technical_features: 由一个领导节点和若干工作者节点构成
在工作节点上对子图进行小批量样本的学习
使用图摘要技术生成子图
technical_features_en: Consists of a leader node and several worker nodes
Performs mini-batch sample learning on subgraphs at worker nodes
Generates subgraphs using graph summarization technology

novelty_points.claim: 提出了一种新的基于边分割的图流划分算法——Sketch-DBH，用于处理大规模图流数据下的子图划分问题。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposed a new edge-segmentation-based graph stream partitioning algorithm, Sketch-DBH, for handling subgraph partitioning problems in large-scale graph stream data.
technical_features: 通过Count-Min Sketch存储每个节点的度数信息
使用最小堆维护图流数据中的高频节点信息
生成单条图流数据即将被分配到的子图编号
technical_features_en: Stored degree information of each node using Count-Min Sketch
Maintained high-frequency node information of graph stream data using a min-heap
Generated the subgraph number for a single graph stream data to be allocated
